survey: A handheld pocket calculator floating at a slight tilt, with its front face toward the camera. The body is a rounded dark-blue slab of even thickness, and its side wall shows evenly along the left and bottom edges. Near the top right of the face sits a small red strip divided into four cells. It reads as a solar cell, set flush on the face inside the body outline. Below it a light-grey display window is set into the face, centred, with a raised bezel. Under the display is a 4×4 keypad: three columns of 12 blue keys for the digits, and one right-hand column of 4 cyan keys for the operators. All keys are the same size, evenly spaced and in straight rows and columns that follow the tilt of the body. Each key rises from the face with a visible gap around it, so it could be pressed. There are no cables, stands or other attachments, and the calculator floats as an icon on a patterned background, which is normal for card art.
